notes.title: The combat system has been improved
notes.content:
As announced, I made several improvements to the aiming and combat systems.
Improvements:
- The angle of view in the lens in aiming mode be increased. 
- Enemies' movement speed fixed.
- The amount of ammo we can find reduced.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622083/7704e6482110bc3625ffc7a73a98df0afed90479.png[/img]

notes.content:
